help.securitycraft.keypad_trapdoor.info: The Keypad Trapdoor acts like a Keypad combined with a Reinforced Iron Trapdoor, where a code has to be inserted in order to open the trapdoor.
module.securitycraft.keypad.allowlist_mo: Adding an allowlist module to a keypad will allow listed players to use the block without knowing the code.
module.securitycraft.keypad.denylist_mod: Adding a denylist module to a keypad will ban listed players from interacting with the block.
module.securitycraft.keypad.smart_module: Adding a smart module to a block that requires a passcode will result in a cooldown being applied after an incorrect code has been entered. During that time, no new code can be entered.
module.securitycraft.keypad.disguise_mod: Adding a disguise module to a keypad makes it render as a disguised block instead of its own model.
death.attack.securitycraft.incorrectPass: %1$s entered an incorrect code whilst fighting %2$s
